svg.title: How regularisation smooths the decision boundary
svg.desc: Three panels of two interleaving half-moons of points with the network's decision boundary drawn as a white line. Without regularisation the boundary bends around individual points (train 93%, test 87%). With an L2 penalty (train 92%, test 88%) and with dropout (train 94%, test 88%) it is smoother. This is an illustrative re-run on similar data, not the notebook's own plot.
svg.text: How regularisation smooths the decision boundary
Illustrative re-run: 20-10-1 ReLU network on 200 freshly generated moon points (pink = class 0, blue = class 1).
